SCENE CONTEXT
Evening living room, medium shot. the man (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, company ID badge on a navy lanyard) sits at the right end of the caramel corduroy sofa, body turned toward the left side of the frame (toward her, off-screen), a cream knit cushion on the seat beside him, hands resting on his thighs.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image, no zoom, no pan, no handheld sway. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, window dark navy, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0s to 0.4s: he opens one palm. 0.4s to 2.2s: he says his line. 2.2s to 3.0s: the palm stays open.

PERFORMANCE
Excuse, mild. No exaggerated acting, no look at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. The man keeps the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No new people enter. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The man says in natural native Korean, low and dry, excusing himself, light, rising: "거기 아직 공사 중이잖아." He says only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural delivery, visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
